exclusions.source_text: Estimated glomerular filtration rate of ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73m2
Karnofsky performance status of at least 70 (i.e. at minimum, "cares for self" but "unable to carry on normal activity or do active work")
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because of the potential deleterious effects of gadolinium on the developing fetus.
women who are breastfeeding are not eligible for this study
